title: Generate and inspect the SDK package
objective: Verify that D3.3-C produces a complete versioned directory and ZIP with an auditable inventory.
preconditions: Release binaries exist. Run PowerShell from D:\GitHub\main\ARTestCLI.

steps.expected: The command returns 0 and prints one SDK directory and one ZIP path.
Headers, nlohmann/json, schemas, docs, tools, MSBuild props, the starter template, notices and both SDK manifests are present.
They declare SDK 0.1.0, Engine API 0.4, native ABI 0.1, experimental stability and a SHA-256 entry for every packaged file except the inventory itself.

title: Validate an installed external consumer
objective: Prove that the ZIP is independently consumable and the resulting extension works through the unchanged Engine.
preconditions: Visual Studio 18 Insiders/v145 and the Release ARTestCLI binary are available. No physical equipment is required.

steps.expected: The source gate, package inventory, archive safety and external /W4 /WX build pass; exit 0.

steps.action: Inspect the output for extensions doctor and offline compile.
steps.expected: The external catalog is active with verified integrity. Compile says no instruments were initialized.

steps.action: Inspect the execution and cleanup output.
steps.expected: The step reports Computed value 84.000000., the simulated driver shuts down and the final verdict is PASSED.
The ZIP was extracted to installed SDK and the consumer was copied to external extension project; both paths contain spaces.

title: Official Release regression and scope
objective: Confirm that SDK distribution is part of the official workflow without changing production extension contracts.

steps.expected: Core, authoring and distribution boundaries pass; the external SDK consumer passes; 139 Google Tests pass.
Overall PASSED, Total 139, Passed 139, Failed 0 and Skipped 0. Attach a screenshot.
ABI remains experimental 0.1; D3.3-B, public licensing, signing, CMake and package feeds are explicitly not claimed complete.
